subject: Audit evidence, retention windows, and BYOK options
messages:
From: MedTech Security <security@medtech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medtech.com>
Date: 2027-07-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit evidence & retention questions for Redwood deployment

Hi Grace,

We're running through the compliance checklist for our Redwood pilot and have a few concrete asks to triage before we sign the pilot SOW. Attached is a short list of the evidence items our audit team expects (medtech_audit_req_2027.pdf). High-level: 

- Audit logs: we need the full event schema and ability to export logs for forensic review.
- Retention: regulatory wants a 7+ year retention plan for certain user data; we need export/archival options.
- BYOK/KMS: is customer-provided key support available for encryption at rest? If so, what KMS providers and what key rotation model?
- SSO: confirmation of SAML 2.0/OIDC support and whether login events are included in the audit stream.

Can your team provide a short evidence pack and a recommended retention/export plan ahead of a 30-minute triage call? We're hoping to get this resolved this week so procurement can finish the paperwork.

Thanks,
Alex Shaw
MedTech Security
security@medtech.com

(attachment: medtech_audit_req_2027.pdf)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: MedTech Security <security@medtech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-15T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence & retention questions for Redwood deployment

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. We're happy to run a focused triage and surface exactly what we can deliver for the pilot. Short answers up front and then a proposed immediate plan: 

- Audit logs: we'll share our audit-schema and a sample export. Events include auth events, request metadata, model used, and tokenization metadata. See attached (redwood_audit_schema_v1.json).
- Retention: we support short-term retention on Hosted with export hooks (S3 push + query API). Dedicated/Private offer customer-configurable retention windows and long-term archival.
- BYOK/KMS: BYOK is supported on Private (customer-managed HSM) and by configuration on Dedicated via cloud KMS; Hosted does not support customer keys today.
- SSO: SAML/OIDC supported; login events are included in the audit stream.

Proposed next steps (what I'd like to do before the triage call):
1) Share an evidence pack (audit schema + sample exports + manifest).
2) Propose two deployment options and timelines (Dedicated pilot with KMS vs Private with HSM).
3) Draft a short MAP with milestones for evidence delivery, infra implementation, and procurement redlines.

I've attached our audit schema and a draft MAP spreadsheet to this thread. Can we schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow afternoon?

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
(attachments: redwood_audit_schema_v1.json, proposed-map-medtech.xlsx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-15T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence & retention questions for Redwood deployment

Grace — quick tech notes to align before we send the evidence pack: 

- Hosted limitations: no customer-managed keys. We can provide a full event stream (JSON lines) and a one-click S3 export of log snapshots but not envelope-encrypt with customer keys.
- Dedicated: supports cloud KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) for encryption at rest and key rotation via customer-managed IAM roles. Recommend documenting rotation windows and who has key access.
- Private: supports HSM and customer key custody; network isolation requirements add ~2 weeks of onboarding time.
- Export format: MedTech asked for long-term retention — we propose baseline rolling 14-day hot window (low-latency query) + nightly snapshot to customer S3 for archival. Snapshot includes fields: timestamp, user_id, api_key_id, model_id, action, request_id, ip, request_payload_hash.

I'll update the MAP with two deliverables: (A) evidence pack (schema + sample export + hash manifest), (B) deployment timeline for Dedicated vs Private. Uploading the MAP now; small edits to the retention rows needed.

— Marcus
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
(attachment: proposed-map-medtech.xlsx)
